title: Dual-path VLM detection of dynamic UI rendering defects — main paired trial

freeze_policy.rule: Once status is 'frozen', no field below may change while EXP001 results are being collected. Any change requires a new experiment_id and a fresh run of ALL clips under BOTH conditions — partial re-runs break the paired design.
freeze_policy.rationale: The PoC's headline comparison (baseline 75.0% vs ours 93.8%) is only attributable if both arms saw the same judge, the same decoding, and the same prompts. Mid-run drift in any of them makes the difference uninterpretable.
unfrozen_by_design: pipeline/score_trial.py — scoring is a pure function of the cached raw responses and may be corrected or extended after the run without invalidating it.

path_layout_migration._note: AMENDMENT, recorded rather than applied silently. EXP001's results were already collected and reported when the repository directories were renamed. The ONLY change made to this frozen file is path strings, so that they resolve to where the same evidence now lives. No design, model, prompt, decoding, dataset or statistical field was touched, and the prompt SHA-256 values below still verify against the templates at their new location. The raw responses were relocated with `git mv` and are byte-identical — see the rename entries in the commit that carries this amendment.
path_layout_migration.reason: 'poc' no longer described a directory holding the formal experiment's pipeline, and 'latest' never described anything.

model.pin_mechanism: GEMINI_MODEL environment variable, verified by vlm_client.connect() against the account's live model list
model.fallback_on_quota: none — a 429 retries the SAME model with backoff; if the model is unavailable the run ABORTS
model._change_required: vlm_client.connect() currently auto-probes the cheapest *-flash model when GEMINI_MODEL is unset. For EXP001 the pin is mandatory, not optional — an unset GEMINI_MODEL must be a hard error, not a fallback to auto-selection.
model._poc_note: The PoC resolved this same id by auto-probing (results/exp001/trial-config.json). EXP001 pins it explicitly so the judge cannot silently change between clips or between sessions.

generation_params._change_required: vlm_client.call_json() currently calls generate_content(parts) with NO generation_config, so the PoC ran at the SDK default (temperature 1.0 — stochastic sampling). EXP001 must pass these values explicitly on every call and record them in the per-clip raw JSON.
generation_params._determinism_caveat: temperature=0 makes the decoder greedy but the Gemini API does not guarantee bit-identical output across sessions. Treat residual variation as measurement noise, not as a broken pin; if it matters, raise repeats_per_call and report majority vote plus disagreement rate.

prompts._integrity: SHA-256 of the exact template string as it appears in pipeline/run_trial.py (before .format()). Verify these before the run; a mismatch means the prompt drifted.

expected_appearance_block.leakage_rule: Generic and byte-identical for every clip. The manifest's per-clip `expectation` field must NEVER be interpolated into any prompt.

conditions._design: Paired / within-clip: every clip is evaluated under both conditions, interleaved per clip, so a quota failure mid-run costs both arms the same clips and pairing survives.

C1_BASELINE.label: Uniform sampling + naive prompt
C1_BASELINE.role: control — replicates the brute-force 'feed the model some frames' approach

C2_OURS.label: Intelligent keyframe selection + dual-path prompt
C2_OURS.frame_selection: strongest sustained pixel transition (before/after pair) + final settled frame

shared_controls._why: Held identical across arms so the only difference is selection strategy + prompt, never image fidelity or cost.
shared_controls.label_blindness: Keyframe selection reads pixels and DOM only; it never sees ground_truth.

dataset.name: dataset_v3
dataset._ratio_rationale: Equal split makes false-positive rate and recall carry equal uncertainty, and matches the PoC's 8/8 split so EXP001 is directly comparable to it.

balancing_strategy._change_from_poc: The PoC deliberately oversampled the two lowest-diff types (blur, skew ×2) because n=16 could not carry every type. At n=120 equal allocation is used instead: per-type recall becomes a reportable number (10 clips/type) and the aggregate anomaly recall is no longer skewed toward the hard types.
balancing_strategy.evaluation_subset: none — all 120 clips are evaluated. build_manifest.py's N_CONTROLS / BUG_SELECTION subsetting is bypassed for EXP001, removing subset-selection as a variable.

subject_application.name: TodoMVC (React)
subject_application._scope_note: Single implementation by design — the only manipulated variable is the condition. Cross-framework generalisation (Vue / VanillaJS) is out of scope for EXP001 and stays future work.

provenance_of_generator._why_not_v2: dataset_v2 fixed two defects that made dataset_v1 unusable as ground truth: (a) Playwright's recorder lost the single defect frame of static broken states, corrupting every flyaway_offset clip and 3/5 vanish_invisible clips; (b) post-injection typing wrote the scenario id — including the bug name — into the on-screen input, leaking the label to any model that reads the screen. dataset_v3 reuses the fixed v2 generator and only scales the case counts.

generator_settings._change_required: The generator uses unseeded Math.random() for todo text, counts, toggles and filter walks. EXP001 declares rng_seed above; the spec must consume it through a seeded PRNG before generation, otherwise dataset_v3 is reproducible only as an artifact, never as a procedure.

quality_gates._role: A clip enters dataset_v3 only if it clears both gates. Rejected clips are regenerated, never relabelled.

video_gate.requirement: the final decoded frame must resemble buggy.png rather than normal.png
video_gate._why: The screenshot gate never decodes the video, so it cannot detect a clip whose footage lost the defect frame.

metrics.primary: accuracy per condition, with Wilson 95% CI
metrics.paired_test: exact McNemar on discordant pairs (C1 vs C2)
secondary: defect_type_match — C2 only, 6-way classification accuracy on correctly detected anomalies
metrics._power_note: At the PoC's observed discordance rate (3/16 ≈ 19%, all favouring C2), n=120 projects to roughly 23 discordant pairs. Exact McNemar reaches p<0.05 once 6 or more discordant pairs fall on one side, so the design is adequately powered if the PoC effect is real.

environment_lock._playwright_note: This is the version actually installed in generator/node_modules. package.json declares '^1.61.1' (floating) and `npx playwright --version` reports 1.62.0 because it resolves a fresh download — pin package.json to the exact 1.61.1 before generating dataset_v3.

reference_poc_result._role: Not a result of EXP001 — recorded so the main trial can be read against the pre-trial it was designed from.
